answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable stake tied to a shared reputation ledger, an atlas of who has actually done honest work, instead of letting anyone spin up a hundred fresh accounts for free. If an agent gets caught copying or lying, its stake is slashed and the record follows it. A whisper of bad behavior, passed between neighbors on the terrace of that ledger, costs more than minting a new identity, so fakes pay real money to play.
